title: A cost is rounded to the cent before its range is chosen
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, two ranges: $0.00 to $10.00 at Default 50% markup, $10.01 and up at Default 20% markup.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with one labor line (line 1).
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 10.005 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Point at the line's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds 10.005 as typed.

Step 7:

  • The cost reads $10.01 (10.005 rounded half away from zero).
  • The line is priced by the second range: $10.01 × 1.20 = $12.012, shown $12.01 (not $10.00 × 1.50 = $15.00).

Step 8:

  • The price details name the $10.01 and up range.
